change: Native declarative plugin panels, fixed host Mix and last-good watch recovery

layout.scope: Control-thread JSON clone, parsing, budgets and descriptor validation. Excludes GPUI layout/paint and DSP; first baseline.

notes: No audio callback or DSP code was changed. The audio benchmark binary does not link the viewer; it cannot measure custom panel or source-hash costs.

Criterion historical changes: baseline +19.199% with a wide confidence interval (reported regression); telemetry +4.4945%, not significant. Retained as observed; this does not establish a regression caused by these UI/control-thread changes.
Viewer capture and build/test processes had exited before the audio microbenchmark. Host scheduling and hardware state were not externally controlled.

Native multiwindow smoke used real drum/gain dylibs and tested syntax/runtime/native rejection, invalid layout fallback, source Mix and recovery. Audio graph reuse while playing is separately tested with a simulated session. Physical desktop hit testing and device/callback endurance remain unverified.
